title: You Don't Have to Decode Every Sign
core_idea: Within the twin flame belief, people often search numbers and coincidences for news about the other person; perhaps the more nourishing focus is the life and healing that are already yours to tend.
text: Many people who believe in twin flames start noticing signs everywhere. The same numbers on a clock. A song on the radio. A name that seems to appear on every street. Some feel these as gentle reminders, and that can be comforting. But it can also turn into a kind of waiting, where every coincidence is studied for news about someone else. Perhaps a sign, if it is one, is less about where another person is going and more about where you are. Your sleep. Your friendships. The things that make you feel alive. A connection that is truly mutual does not need to be decoded. It shows itself plainly, in respect and in freedom. Meanwhile, your own life is here, asking for your attention.
description: A calm reflection on the twin flame belief: perhaps signs are invitations to tend your own life, not puzzles about someone else.
